Earlier 717 scoped assertions also cover classic regressions, source contracts and package provenance on their recorded revisions. Normal-clock world shutdown is clean; accelerated world-only audio shutdown failure remains retained.

jobs.title: Rama kit, Sangam map and native screens

Four unchanged originals are displayed here. Staged views do not establish ordinary input, continuous motion, final art or physical-GPU performance.
jobs.next_step: Complete ordinary input and motion review, refine one representative weapon/site encounter, and obtain human art/feel acceptance.

jobs.title: Verified source and local portable native artifacts

Extracted Linux passed ordinary menu/Casual/deploy/shop purchase/movement/pause/menu/native Quit 0 on Forward+ llvmpipe. Windows execution is unrun. The frozen package predates four committed map/minimap/hint changes; exact-source distinctions are preserved. No replacement public executable release is claimed.
